commercialPurpose: Open an editorial website with mood, story promise, and browsing invitation through a controlled photographic masthead.
purposeLayer: Hero sells the publication mood and invites reading without dense conversion pressure.
anatomyLayer: Wide photo stage, centered title overlay, metadata or category cue, one small CTA, optional slider arrows.
hierarchyLayer: Mood image first, headline second, small CTA third, slider controls last.
gridRhythmLayer: Centered overlay on a wide cinematic image block with generous white header space above.
densityLimitLayer: Use one headline, one metadata line, one CTA, one controlled media system, and optional previous/next arrows.
originalityLayer: Learn the cinematic editorial masthead role only; transform image ratio, overlay style, CTA treatment, and brand mood for new products.
usageRuleLayer: Use for editorial, travel, lifestyle, boutique hospitality, and creator templates needing mood before content grids.
sectionSilhouette: wide image stage beneath airy brand header
compositionTension: soft centered copy floating over a large photographic field
focalPath: image atmosphere to headline to small CTA to slider arrows
negativeSpaceShape: horizontal breathing band above and below the media stage
depthLayering: photo plane with text overlay and light control elements
moduleScaleVariation: oversized image with small text and controls
breakoutBehavior: media spans wider than text rhythm but remains framed by page margins
antiCopyBoundary: Do not copy the exact woman/photo mood, gold button, centered copy placement, or slider arrow styling.

hyperAccuracyReceipt.nonCopyBoundary: Do not copy the Pallas-style script logo, muted gold CTA treatment, right-sidebar widget order, image set, or exact editorial spacing.
